solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: US puritan dejected by corrupt ones

parts.note: feeling blue means feeling dejected

indicators.note: corrupt means spoiled or altered, so the letters of ones are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puritan is dismayed by people who have gone bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dejected' looks like describing the puritan's mood, but it supplies the colour word meaning low in spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Bluenose is American slang for a prudish, strait-laced moralist.

clue.text: Pierce, male friend in centre of Amiens

indicators.note: in places the male friend inside the letters from Amiens
centre of takes the two middle letters of the word Amiens

parts.note: the French city's two central letters
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone pierces a male companion in the middle of the French city of Amiens.
explanation.walkthrough: The two central letters of AMIENS are I and E; M and PAL go between them.
explanation.definitionFit: To impale is to pierce something through with a sharp stake or point.

clue.text: Father unhappy with European article about Californian city

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
sad means unhappy

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the article is read backwards

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A sad father and a European item travel around a city in California.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns AN into NA at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasadena is a city near Los Angeles, home of the Rose Bowl.

clue.text: Training lieutenant to sprint

parts.note: PE, physical education, is training of the body
Lt is the military abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: An officer is put through training in running fast.
explanation.definitionFit: To pelt is to run at great speed, as in pelting down the road.

clue.text: Criminal may receive this, delivered enclosed with drug

parts.note: sent means delivered
enc is the abbreviation for enclosed, used on letters
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A criminal might be posted a package containing drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A convicted criminal receives a punishment such as a prison term from the judge.

clue.text: Immoral to ignore series of religious books some years

indicators.note: to ignore means leaving these letters out of the longer word

parts.note: decadent means morally degenerate
NT, the New Testament, is a series of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone immoral neglects scripture for a number of years.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove NT, the New Testament, from DECADENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A decade is a period of ten years, so a particular quantity of years.

clue.text: Close new organ

parts.note: the ear is an organ of hearing

explanation.walkthrough: 'Close' here is the adjective, not the verb to shut.
explanation.definitionFit: Near and close are synonyms for being a short distance away.

clue.text: Way of cooking meat in France, on vacation

indicators.note: in places the meat inside the remaining letters
on vacation means the word France is emptied, leaving only its first and last letters

parts.note: first and last letters of France
lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: A description of a way to cook meat while holidaying in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on vacation' means emptied, as a vacated house is, so only the outside letters of France stay.
explanation.definitionFit: Flambé describes food doused in spirit and set alight, a dramatic cooking technique.

clue.text: Crustacean caught by Scotsman on net

indicators.note: on in an across clue means placed after, so the caught-and-Scotsman pieces come after the net word

parts.note: to net a fish is to land it
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
Rab is a typical Scottish man's name, short for Robert

explanation.surface: A crab is caught in a Scottish fisherman's net.
explanation.definitionFit: The land crab is a crab species that lives mainly ashore, a kind of shellfish.

clue.text: Greek character risked ace

parts.note: to bet is to risk money on something
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A Greek person gambled on an ace at the card table.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Newsman set about new objective

indicators.note: set about means placed around, so the editor goes round the other letter

parts.note: ED, editor, is a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A journalist begins working on a fresh goal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set about' looks like 'began', but it means placed around.
explanation.definitionFit: An end is a goal or aim, as in the end justifying the means.

clue.text: Joker's trick involving TV, newspapers, etc

indicators.note: involving means wrapping round, so the trick contains the other piece

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
the media is TV, newspapers and the like

explanation.surface: A prankster's stunt gets coverage across television and the press.
explanation.definitionFit: A comedian is a funny person who tells jokes.

clue.text: Popular spice, ready for eating

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to season food is to spice it

explanation.surface: A well-liked spice is ready to be added to a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Produce in season is ripe and available now, so it is at its best to consume.

clue.text: Large-scale English film

parts.note: a pic is an informal word for a film

explanation.walkthrough: 'Large-scale English film' looks like a description of a single movie, but the definition is just the opening adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Epic as an adjective means grand and ambitious in size or scope.

clue.text: One meets very tardy daughter, standing apart

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
so means very, as in so good
late means tardy

explanation.surface: Someone greets a daughter who is very late and keeps their distance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something isolated is set apart or alone, separate from others.

clue.text: Highly valued ruminant animal discussed

indicators.note: discussed means spoken about, so the animal's name is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a deer is a ruminant, chewing the cud

explanation.surface: A cherished cud-chewing animal is the topic of conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dear is precious or treasured, also costly.

clue.text: Disciplinarian hit staff

parts.note: to ram is to strike forcefully
a rod is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: A strict figure strikes someone with a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A ramrod is an informal term for a stern, rigid person who enforces rules.

clue.text: That lady's driver follows small forest

indicators.note: follows means the golf club comes after the other pieces

parts.note: her means belonging to that woman
a wood is a golf club used for driving

explanation.surface: A woman's chauffeur trails behind a little forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' looks like a motorist, but in golf a wood is a club for long drives.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherwood Forest in Nottinghamshire is famed as Robin Hood's haunt.

clue.text: Front of boat lifted, belly occasionally tremulous

indicators.note: lifted in a down clue means the letters are written upwards, read backwards

parts.note: the bow is the front of a boat

indicators.note: occasionally takes every other letter of the word belly

parts.note: first, third and fifth letters of belly

explanation.surface: A boat's front rises and someone's stomach quivers now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: BOW written upwards gives WOB; belly's odd letters give BLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Wobbly describes something shaky and unsteady, trembling.

clue.text: Consumed tea messily

indicators.note: messily means in disorder, so the letters of tea are mixed up

explanation.definitionFit: Ate is the past tense of eat, so it means swallowed or devoured.

clue.text: Huge land mass of Sumatra is amazing northwards

indicators.note: northwards says the hidden letters are read backwards
of here means taken out of, so the answer lies inside the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A traveller admires Sumatra as the most impressive part of a vast continent.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft named no word signalling the hiding; 'of' does that job, meaning drawn out of the words that follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia is the largest continent on Earth.

clue.text: Tramp's house with bad smell

parts.note: BO, body odour, is a bad smell

explanation.surface: A vagrant's home has an unpleasant odour.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobo is a homeless wanderer, chiefly in American usage.

clue.text: Ray's gymnastic apparatus

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a shaft of light
second meaning: the narrow balance bar in gymnastics

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray's' reads as a person's name, but it is a shaft of light, and the 's is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a line of light and the wooden bar gymnasts balance on.

clue.text: Type of coffee — rep's working fuel?

indicators.note: working means set in action, so the letters of rep's are reworked

parts.note: Esso is a well-known fuel brand

explanation.surface: A sales rep runs on strong coffee to keep going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges REPS into ESPR, followed by ESSO, a brand of petrol.
explanation.definitionFit: Espresso is strong coffee made by forcing steam through ground beans.

clue.text: Grumble about the Italian switching faith

indicators.note: about means going round, so the grumble encloses the other letters

parts.note: to beef is to complain or grumble

indicators.note: switching means the two letters swap places

parts.note: il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: Someone complains about an Italian changing religion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grumble' is a verb in the surface, but to beef is British slang for to complain.
explanation.definitionFit: A belief is a religious conviction or creed.

clue.text: Enthusiast Angela, not half, in party dance

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast

indicators.note: in places the shortened name inside the party

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: not half means only the first half of the name Angela is kept

parts.note: first three of the six letters

explanation.surface: A fan named Angela, only half there, is dancing at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: Half of ANGELA is ANG, which goes into DO.
explanation.definitionFit: The fandango is a lively Spanish dance in triple time.
